title: [Master]-Inconsistent Validation of Non-Deductible VAT % for Purchase Lines Sharing the Same VAT Identifier- #10607
summary: Fixes inconsistent validation of Non-Deductible VAT % on purchase lines that share the same VAT identifier. Two lines were removed from the Non-Ded. VAT Impl. codeunit, and tests were updated and added across the W1, AU, CZ, IT and RU layers.
key_points: Addresses inconsistent Non-Deductible VAT % validation for purchase lines with the same VAT identifier
Small change in codeunit Non-Ded. VAT Impl. (2 lines removed)
New unit tests in the W1 NonDeductibleUT codeunit and the CZ purchase posting tests
Existing non-deductible VAT posting tests adjusted in several localization layers
